items.title: Syntomicity is preserved by a flat surjective morphism of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Given a commutative triangle of schemes with f : X -> Y surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation and p : X -> S syntomic, the lemma asserts that both q : Y -> S and f are syntomic (statement lines 4712-4728). The proof obtains finite presentation of q from the flat-finitely-presented permanence lemma and flatness of q from the permanence lemma for flat morphisms, then uses the criterion that syntomicity is equivalent to flatness plus finite presentation plus local complete intersection fibres to reduce to a statement about local rings; after taking the fibre at a point s and picking x over y, the ring map O_{Y,y} -> O_{X,x} is a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings with the target a complete intersection, and Avramov's result yields that both O_{Y,y} and O_{X,x}/m_y O_{X,x} are complete intersections (proof lines 4730-4751). The level is H3: three separate inputs are combined and the fibre reduction to a single ring-theoretic statement is displayed.
